figure.message: A maximum over layers makes the calibration threshold follow the largest random-pairing baseline; where this baseline grows with size at least as fast as the observed maximum, calibration removes or reverses the CKA size trend, while mKNN, whose baseline is the same at every layer, keeps its trend.

wording_notes.at_least_as_fast: BLOOMZ gains from 0.56B to 7.1B: c_alpha +0.048, observed max +0.048, largest baseline +0.049, and the trend is removed (s_cal Tr -0.02), so the message says 'at least as fast as', not 'faster than'.
wording_notes.openllama_ranks: In (f) the OpenLLaMA level lines look nearly parallel at print size (gains c_alpha +0.022, observed max +0.016; the difference is 1.5 pt at the axis scale), yet Tr after subtraction is -0.59: Tr is the mean over vision models of a per-model Spearman over 3 sizes, so a small excess of baseline growth that recurs across vision models gives a large negative rank trend (counts in openllama.cka_layermax_per_vit_rho_counts). The Results text should say this.
